name: AreaManagerStoreVisit
tagline: Scored store visits, action plans and follow-up – a complete area manager app for Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A full store visit module in one PCF control: dashboard with visit KPIs, region league and attention list; visit list with chips, grouping and bulk actions; store league with trends and a section heat map; action-plan board from overdue to verified; and a visit plan calendar with the stores due. Weighted scorecards with critical sections, evidence comments, required actions for low scores, store acknowledgement, action verification and automatic follow-up visits.
features: Weighted scorecard from a simple list (Customer service:25;Health & safety:20…)
Critical sections cap the rating at Fail
Evidence comment required for low scores and NA
At least one action for every section at or below the threshold before submit
Store manager acknowledgement, action done → verified, close only when complete
Automatic follow-up visit date after Needs improvement / Fail
Visit cycle coverage: due, overdue, never visited and follow-up states
Store league with trend sparkline and delta, section heat map
Calendar planning with duplicate and past-date checks, cancel / re-open with reason
Roles: store, area and regional manager
Undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, phone layout
